items.title: [ECG] Applications Open: i-SEA Fellowship Programme 2026 at NTU WKWSCI
items.author: Klyne Mary Ann
items.description:
Hi students,
Interested in
content creation, social media or digital storytelling
?
Applications are now open for the
Influence for Impact in Southeast Asia (i-SEA) Fellowship Programme 2026
, organised by the Centre for Information Integrity and the Internet (IN-cube) at the Wee Kim Wee School of Communication and Information, Nanyang Technological University, Singapore.
The month-long hybrid international fellowship brings together aspiring student content creators from Southeast Asia, China and India to learn, exchange ideas and explore how to create ethical, responsible and impactful digital content in the age of AI.
The programme includes online masterclasses and activities, followed by an
in-person programme
in Singapore from 7 to 12 December 2026.
What can you look forward to?
- Learn from industry professionals, academics and content creators
- Take part in industry visits, with previous visits including TikTok, SPH Media and Mediacorp
- Meet and exchange ideas with student creators from Southeast Asia, China and India
- Receive a daily stipend during the in-person programme
- Receive a Certificate of Accomplishment from NTU upon completion of the programme
Who can apply?
For Singapore applicants, you must be currently enrolled in a Junior College, Polytechnic or University.
Applications close: 30 August 2026
Find out more and apply:
www.iseafellowship.com
For any questions about the programme or application, please contact
incube@ntu.edu.sg
.
We look forward to receiving your application!
Warm regards,
Centre for Information Integrity and the Internet (IN-cube)
Wee Kim Wee School of Communication and Information
Nanyang Technological University, Singapore

items.title: [SL] Volunteer Recruitment for West Coast ROCKS Event
items.author: Ng Su Chan
items.description:
Hey Hwa Chong! 👋
Looking for a fun and meaningful way to spend your holidays? YLEP is looking for volunteers for an upcoming West Coast ROCKS Event in collaboration with West Coast Community Club! ✨🎸This event will feature a series of live music, carnival games, food and fireworks finale! 🎇🎆
What will volunteers do?
On the event day itself, volunteers will help usher crowds into the venue, as well as at the end of the event.  Volunteers will also help to man booths, distribute goodie bags and facilitate activities for the community. More instructions will be given closer to the date.
📍 West Coast Park Grand Lawn
🕒 No preparation sessions
🎉 Event Day:
29 August 2026
Shift 1 : 3pm to 7.30pm
Shift 2 : 5.15pm to 10.30pm
Note : Dinner will be provided! 🍽️
Why join us?
🔥 Connect with others and make new friends
🔥 Have fun and gain new experiences
🔥 CIP hours provided
🔥 Opportunity to take over and lead the project in the future
👍 No prior experience needed!
SIGN UP NOW!
https://forms.gle/at5Go92Bfuo4FQvr7
If you have any questions, feel free to gchat 221622u@student.hci.edu.sg
